status: confirmation; all four declared rules excluded
model: GPT2XL TaxiGPT random-walks, 48 blocks, width 1600, FP32 eager attention
scope: The L18 nearest-centroid current-node decode at the final move of complete 27..34-move corpus rides. Terminal goal contexts retained, matching the upstream experiment. Conditional on this checkpoint, fitted readout, map and intervention; not navigation, semantic content of K/V, unique natural computation, or intermediate transit localization.
fit_deviation: Locally rebuilt centroids, bounded training sample and FP32 storage; not the authors' frozen centroid artifacts. Same nearest-centroid scoring and 90%-energy subspace rule.

inference.intervals: Two-sided exact hypergeometric inversion for eight binary population rates under finite-population simple random sampling; Bonferroni alpha/8. Development uses Clopper-Pearson descriptively.
inference.full_drop: P(U=1,KV=0)-P(U=0,KV=1), interval from simultaneous component intervals
inference.gates: Baseline lower bound >=.90; full-drop lower bound >.20; random disagreement upper bound <=.10; all numerical/integrity checks pass.
inference.candidate_status: Excluded if either mismatch lower bound >.10; adequate if both upper bounds <=.10; otherwise undecided. Compatible set includes adequate and undecided. A sole undecided survivor is evidence_insufficient, not identification.

note: Rates are paired correctness mismatches, not accuracy differences or shares of a mechanism.
